title: Countup
description: Counts its host's number up from a start value to an end value, easing out, the first time it scrolls into view. It applies to any element, so it names no host.

from.description: The number the count starts at.

to.description: The number the count ends at. Without it the host's own text is the target, and 100 when that is empty.

duration.description: How long the count takes, in milliseconds.

prefix.description: Text written before the number, such as $.

suffix.description: Text written after the number, such as % or +.

decimals.description: Digits shown after the decimal point.
